script.thesis: Forgiveness is setting the weight down, not making them earn the lift.
script.monologue: Don't make them earn it first. You set the heavy bag down. You place the river stone. Put the weight down. You open the old letter. You walk the dusk river wall. You unclench in the doorway. The bag sits empty now. You walk away empty-handed.
